Name: Em's goose and geese (SVE animals)
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
A new design and four colour options for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] goose. Making them softer and more realistic-looking
It includes the goose and Marnie's livestock shop icon
Available for Content Patcher and Alternative Textures

The different types are:
Embden (white)
Greylag (brown)
Scania (brown white)
Canada (black brown)

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/5ySh95dL/AT.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Geese AT"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Buy the paint tools from Robin at the Carpenter's shop
With the scissors selected, left-click the goose and choose its type
Enjoy!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Geese CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

The default is the Embden goose. To choose a different type:
Open and close the game once
There is now a [i]config.json[/i] file in the goose mod folder
Open the [i]config.json[/i] file, and simply replace "[color=#e69138]Embden[/color]" with the name of the type you like
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!

Thank you [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BethieQ82/mods]Beth[/url] for helping me troubleshoot the SVE animals!
The other icons in the shop menu image are [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Rivalrabbit/mods?pk_vid=79f6dcb3273050a417538605747beed4]Em's animals[/url]
